facts.business: TCI Industries Limited is engaged in generating revenue from services by upgrading infrastructure and maintaining property assets, including sea-retaining walls and platforms, to attract customer segments.

capacity_or_capex.item: Repairs and reconstruction of sea-retaining wall and filling of washed-out area (22,000 sq ft)

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company remains optimistic about achieving better results in the current year and the near future.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matter: Contingent liabilities related to various tax and legal disputes pending before authorities/courts, where outcomes cannot be easily predicted and may or may not result in significant liabilities.

key_risks: Cyclone damage to sea-retaining walls and property infrastructure
Dependence on Mumbai Port Trust (MbPT) for repairs to their portion of sea-retaining wall/platform, which they have refused to carry out
Ongoing tax and legal disputes with uncertain outcomes leading to contingent liabilities
Low current ratio (0.89) indicating potential liquidity constraints
Negative net profit margin in prior year (-0.76) though improved to 0.09 in current year
